build_differentiable_star_planner: build a DifferentiableStarPlanner module to compute differentiable A-star paths on 2D occupancy grids with obstacle cost maps
run_differentiable_star_planner_forward: run the DifferentiableStarPlanner forward pass with obstacle maps, start/goal maps, and coordinate grids to get a path
create_soft_argmin_module: create a SoftArgMin module that computes a softmax-weighted argmin over a 2D tensor using configurable beta temperature
create_hard_argmin_module: create a HardArgMin module that finds the exact argmin index and returns corresponding 2D coordinates from a tensor
init_neighborhood_to_channels_kernel: init a convolutional kernel that maps a 3x3 neighborhood into separate channels for neighbor-aware cost computation
